title: Answer: the papers state no account of intelligence

statements.text: Chronoflux takes no position on what intelligence is. The nearest it comes is the intelligibility of the universe to finite observers: observation proceeds through finite causal reach, duration, memory and energy, and such observers can still build a stable lawful description as long as enough relational coherence survives their changes of view.
statements.scope: a reading of the papers cited in this folder, July 2026 and earlier

sources.quote: Observation always proceeds through finite causal reach, finite duration, finite memory, finite energy, and incomplete accessibility.
Finite observers may still construct stable lawful description provided enough relational coherence survives across admissible observational transformation.
